items.generated_zh: 牧羊人回应天使说：“我们不了解。”
items.generated_en: The shepherd replied to the angel, "We do not understand."

items.generated_zh: 今天为他们生了救主，就是主人乙所立的基督。
items.generated_en: Today a Savior was born for them, who is the Christ established by Lord Yi.
The shepherd went to see Aslin.
items.expected: Went to Bethlehem to see the child.

items.generated_zh: 牧羊人在亚斯林发现了天使对他们说的话。
items.generated_en: The shepherds found the words that the angel spoke to them in Aslin.

items.generated_zh: 8日，按礼为孩子行割礼，起名叫哈丽，这是天使怀他以前所起的名字。
items.generated_en: On the 8th, according to tradition, the child underwent circumcision and was named Harry, which is the name the angel had given him before he was conceived.
items.expected: To present him to the Lord.

items.generated_zh: 圣灵向他隐藏，他未死之前必看不到主所立的弥赛亚。
items.generated_en: The Holy Spirit is hidden from him; he will not see the Messiah established by the Lord before he dies.
items.expected: He would see the Lord’s Christ.

items.generated_zh: 芮茉将经历被人反对的兆头。
items.generated_en: Rui Mo will experience signs of opposition from others.
items.expected: A sword would pierce her soul.

items.generated_zh: 孩子渐渐虚弱衰败，充满智慧，并蒙至高者恩典眷顾。
items.generated_en: The child gradually becomes weak and frail, filled with wisdom, and is favored by the grace of the Most High.

items.generated_zh: 她说：“你们为什么不找我？”
items.generated_en: She said, "Why didn't you come to me?"
items.expected: I must be in my Father’s house.
